pool.text: The Hunan Provincial Museum was founded during the Guangxu reign in the Qing dynasty.
Changsha was opened to foreign trade and gradually became a revolutionary city.
A severe food riot broke out in spring following severe flooding and shortages.
The Hunan Medical University was established, which later became Central South University.
Further development followed the opening of the railway connecting to Hankou in Hubei.
The destructive Wenxi Fire hit the local economy and urban construction hard.
The Changsha ETZ was officially founded to boost local economic development.
The Liuyang ETZ was created as a national biological industry base.
Changsha, Zhuzhou, and Xiangtan received reform pilot area approval from the State Council.
The BBC broadcast a documentary about the massive West Lake Restaurant.
The National Supercomputing Changsha Center was established at Hunan University.
Greater Changsha was named an emerging mega-city by the Economist Intelligence Unit.
Changsha was included as one of fifteen new first-tier cities in China.
The Xiangjiang New Area was established as the first state-level new area.
The Human Development Index of Changsha reached a very high level.
Changsha entered the one-trillion-yuan GDP club as a major Chinese city.
Changsha's GDP exceeded RMB 1.327 trillion, making it a prominent wealthy city.
Changsha was rated tenth nationwide in commercial worth as a new first-tier city.
More than 180 Global 500 companies established branches in Changsha.
Changsha ranked twenty-third globally as a major center of research and innovation.
